description: This file defines data model structures related to chat sessions in the OpenClawChat UI module. It includes models for chat choices, session defaults, individual session entries, and a list response containing multiple sessions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializers for the data structures, used to create instances with provided property values.

methods.name: selectionID
methods.description: Generates a provider-qualified model reference used for UI selection and identification.

methods.name: displayLabel
methods.description: Returns the selection ID for display purposes.
